entry.title: Brazilia Lambada — Single
experienceTags: Pairings: Coffee, rye, dark rum, cola (projected)
Occasion: Full-flavour CAO test, long evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Toasty earth, nuts, floral depth and dark Brazilian-wrapper richness define CAO Brazilia, with cocoa, coffee, spice and tobacco sweetness commonly reported around the Lambada. The 6″ × 50 Toro uses Brazilian Arapiraca over Nicaraguan binder and filler and is officially positioned medium-full to full bodied. This is a strong flavour-fit test for the catalogue, though the 50 ring gauge is well outside the ergonomic sweet spot. Untasted here, so Strength 8 and Quality 7 remain projections and Flavour stays unrated.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. Cigarworld currently lists the exact CAO Brazilia Lambada 6″ × 50 single at A$55 and available to add to cart. This is intentionally a taster despite the large ring gauge because the dark, rich CAO profile is much more relevant than another mild neutral premium.

note: Add CAO Brazilia Lambada as a taster. Cigarworld currently lists the exact 6 x 50 single at A$55 and Add to Cart. Official CAO profile confirms Brazilian Arapiraca wrapper, Nicaraguan binder/filler, medium-full body and toasty/earthy/nutty/floral notes. Leave Flavour unrated until tasted.
